eyebrow: The starting point: a tangled function
code:
def estimate_ghz_fidelity(n_qubits,
    shots=2048, use_real_hardware=
    False):
  qc = QuantumCircuit(n_qubits)
  qc.h(0)
  for i in range(1, n_qubits):
    qc.cx(0, i)
  qc.measure_all()
  if use_real_hardware: ...
  else: ...  # construction, backend
            # choice, and analysis,
            # all fused together
caption: Construction and execution fused, backend chosen via a boolean flag, no way to test circuit logic without running a backend.
Construction (Lesson 10), backend injection (Lesson 11), and analysis — each independently testable.

code:
def test_each_extracted_function():
  qc = build_ghz_circuit(3)
  assert qc.num_qubits == 3

  fidelity = fidelity_from_counts(
    {"000":900,"111":80,"010":20},
    n_qubits=3, shots=1000)
  assert abs(fidelity - 0.98) < 1e-9
caption: fidelity_from_counts is now testable with a hand-constructed dictionary and zero quantum execution — impossible in the original.
